review.why: Makes Slack-ready animated GIFs with Pillow: size limits, a GIF builder, a validator, easing functions and animation recipes.
review.summary: States Slack's size, frame rate and color limits, then shows a workflow: build frames with Pillow drawing primitives, assemble them with a GIF builder, optimize for emoji and check the result with a validator. It adds easing functions, frame helpers and recipes for shake, pulse, bounce, spin, fade, slide, zoom and particle bursts.
strengths: Slack's dimensions, frame rate and color limits are stated up front
A validator checks that the GIF is Slack-ready
cautions: Narrow use: animated GIFs for one chat app
The utility modules in core/ are not read here
No pre-made graphics: everything is drawn from primitives
